_note: The data layer's entry point. There is no build step and no directory listing over fetch(), so every file must be enumerated here — this is a hard constraint, not a convenience. One fetch of this file tells the loader everything else to fetch, and it doubles as the load-order record the diff export reports against.

config._note: Layers resolve in LAYER_ORDER: base -> chapter -> shaft -> mission -> event -> sandbox. Each layer file may carry a 'tunables' block (dot-path merged) and a 'patch' block (catalog entities addressed by id).

catalog._note: Entity definitions. The key is the catalogue name used by 'patch' blocks and by cross-reference validation; the value lists every file contributing entities to it.

content._note: Narrative payloads. Additive — entities self-gate on their own 'chapter' field and preconditions rather than being switched on by a layer.

tables._note: Lookup tables, not entity collections — loaded verbatim and never id-indexed. Use this group for a file whose shape is pools or maps rather than a list of things with ids (CONVENTIONS.md §2). levels.json belongs here and not in catalog: it holds three unrelated shapes (depthBands, levelTemplate, excavation), so id-indexing it silently picks whichever array comes first.
